title: Codex managed worker availability follows real CLI errors rather than quoted model/tool transcript text
acceptance: Why: Captain authorized overnight completion of existing PR repairs and external repository dispatch. Actual worker-shira-t164-r2 and worker-ayo-t162-r2 produced authenticated Codex completed-turn final WORKER_COMPLETE, CLI exit0 and verified final provenance, but adapter exit2. _FM_SIG matched six quoted eNotFound occurrences in T164 JSON command output and two quoted authentication required/not logged in terms in T162 model/tool transcript. This falsely announces unavailable, interferes with completion cleanup and is a prerequisite for trustworthy external worker dispatch. Commit this task spec.

For managed Codex JSONL runs, distinguish real CLI/provider errors and nonzero launch/CLI outcomes from strings inside model messages, quoted code, tool arguments/results and instructions. A completed current invocation with CLI0 and valid completed-turn final WORKER_COMPLETE must not become unavailable solely because those fields quote authentication/quota/network text. Preserve real launch/login refusal, actual auth/quota/network errors, nonzero CLI failures and their configured fallback behavior. Do not blindly remove provider error checks or treat all CLI0 logs as trustworthy completion.

Bind evidence to the current attempt and role. Preserve T163 reviewer final-answer provenance, sandbox boundaries and recovery logic. Do not grant model write access to transport receipts. Non-managed/legacy and other vendors keep their existing explicit contracts unless a required compatible helper change is proven and tested; no broad T149 stream telemetry implementation.

Fail-first regressions include the actual completed-worker JSONL shape with quoted ENOTFOUND and login text in command output/model text, real structured error/turn.failed provider auth/quota/network events, launch failures, nonzero CLI exits, absent final and stale attempt evidence. Verify completed final-only role status and CLI/adapter outcomes are consistent, without weakening malformed/truncated-stream handling. Standard CI/gates and firstmate real stock round validate; workers do not run suites or models.

Firstmate records one real Codex stock worker from the immutable candidate with quoted fixture/error text, actual CLI0, terminal WORKER_COMPLETE, correct adapter classification and truthful Herdr ownership/completion/retention evidence. Approval remains independent and current-head CI/six gates required.
